content:
lucy: Quick idea 3 test small copy + tier label variants in the pricing calculator results. want to see impact on demo requests + webinar signups.
ben: which labels?
lucy: Option A: Starter / Scale / Enterprise. Option B: Foundational / Growth / Enterprise+.
tian: Also test CTA wording: 'Request a demo' vs 'Talk to sales' vs 'Optimize my estimate'.
eden: routing: if result_band == Enterprise+ then auto-create lead and ping #sdr-inbox, else capture email for nurture.
pricingbot: Created experiment PR-9123, tag=calc_label_cta_test
ben: small UX note: show one-liner rationale under the tier so users see why we mapped them there. e.g., 'Recommended for lightweight assistants and prototypes.'
lucy: add FAQ entry: 'Why are estimates different from cloud invoices?' copy: 'We model token-level inference cost and include recommended batch/concurrency assumptions; real invoices may vary based on usage patterns and other infra costs.'
tian: analytics events: calc_view, tier_click, cta_click, lead_created. I'll add to GA4 and segment.
eden: timeline: prototype in staging tomorrow, run 2-week test. webinar tie-in: promote winners on webinar 'Decoding LLM inference costs' scheduled wk3.
lucy: assigning: ben build, tian analytics, eden copy + FAQ, i'll own experiment tracking. sync Mon 11am. :calendar:
